cards.english_title: A Network Glitch Delayed Check-In at Incheon
cards.korean_desc: 10월 30일 인천공항 체크인이 지연됐다. 공항은 ARINC 항공망 불안정을 원인으로 봤다. 1터미널 8곳과 2터미널 5곳에서 통신이 끊겼다. 오후에는 중국 항공사 세 곳이 발권을 멈췄다.
cards.english_desc: On October 30, a network disruption delayed check-in at Incheon Airport. The airport connected the problem to instability in the ARINC airline network. Communication outages affected eight airlines in Terminal 1 and five in Terminal 2. By afternoon, three Chinese carriers had effectively stopped normal ticketing.
cards.takeaway_english: The next question is whether ARINC and airlines can prevent another disruption.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 과제는 ARINC와 항공사의 재발 방지다.

why_it_matters.english: A check-in failure can quickly create long airport lines.
why_it_matters.korean: 체크인 장애는 공항에 긴 줄을 만든다.

why_it_matters.english: Passengers with connections may face extra travel problems.
why_it_matters.korean: 환승 승객은 추가 여행 문제를 겪을 수 있다.

parties.label: Incheon Airport
parties.english: It faced passenger-processing delays and investigated the network problem.
parties.korean: 여객 수속 지연을 겪고 장애를 조사했다.

parties.label: Three Chinese airlines
parties.english: China Southern, China Eastern and Air China stopped normal ticketing by afternoon.
parties.korean: 중국 항공사 세 곳은 발권을 멈췄다.

parties.label: Passengers
parties.english: They waited in long lines and some feared missed connections.

views.label: Incheon Airport officials
views.english: They linked the disruption to instability in the US-based ARINC network.
views.korean: 공항은 미국 ARINC망 불안정을 원인으로 봤다.

views.label: Some passenger reports
views.english: Passengers described severe queues and possible effects on connecting travel.
views.korean: 승객들은 긴 줄과 환승 차질을 말했다.

disagree.english: The airport had not completed a detailed investigation, so the cause and flight effects remained unsettled.
disagree.korean: 조사가 끝나지 않아 원인과 운항 영향은 확정되지 않았다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 공항은 공동망 장애에 어떻게 대비해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Golfzon County Sale Sparks a Fight Over Contract Rights
cards.korean_desc: MBK는 골프존카운티를 약 1조 8천억 원에 팔기로 했다. 컨소시엄은 MBK의 지배 지분을 사게 된다. MBK는 2018년 동반매도 조항을 근거로 들었다. 골프존홀딩스는 IPO와 경영권 보호를 기대했다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: MBK agreed to sell Golfzon County for a valuation of about 1.8 trillion won. The buyer would acquire MBK’s controlling stake through a consortium. MBK says a 2018 drag-along clause allows it to include Golfzon Holdings’ shares. Golfzon Holdings says the investment was meant to pursue an IPO and protect its control.
cards.hook: A 1.8 trillion-won sale sparked a dispute.
cards.takeaway_english: The dispute may move toward legal action over ownership and lease terms.
cards.takeaway_korean: 갈등은 소유권과 임대 조건의 법적 다툼으로 갈 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: A forced sale could change who controls a major golf-course business.
why_it_matters.korean: 강제 매각은 골프장 기업의 지배자를 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Lease terms may affect Golfzon County’s operating costs.
why_it_matters.korean: 임대 조건은 골프존카운티 비용에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

parties.label: MBK Partners
parties.english: It agreed to sell its controlling stake and says the contract permits a forced joint sale.
parties.korean: 지배 지분 매각을 추진하며 동반매도권을 주장한다.

parties.label: Golfzon Holdings
parties.english: It says the sale conflicts with the original IPO and management-control understanding.
parties.korean: 매각이 원래 IPO 약속과 다르다고 주장한다.

parties.label: Sienna Group and Ciel Asset Management
parties.english: Their consortium agreed to buy the controlling stake in Golfzon County.
parties.korean: 두 회사 컨소시엄은 지배 지분을 사기로 했다.

views.label: MBK Partners
views.english: MBK says Golfzon Holdings signed the drag-along clause and knew control depended on a successful IPO.
views.korean: MBK는 골프존홀딩스가 동반매도 조항에 동의했다고 말한다.

views.label: Golfzon Holdings
views.english: Golfzon Holdings says it invested expecting an IPO and protected management control.
views.korean: 골프존홀딩스는 IPO와 경영권 보호를 기대했다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The disagreement concerns both the contract wording and whether the original investment purpose still controls the sale.
disagree.korean: 갈등은 계약 문구와 투자 목적의 해석에서 생겼다.

cards.english_title: A Novel Turns Grief Into a Water Ghost Story
cards.korean_desc: 윤지현 소설은 수진과 되살아난 미래를 따른다. 수진은 미래를 잃은 현실을 받아들이지 못한다. 미래가 돌아온 뒤 이상한 죽음과 폭우가 마을을 위협한다. 수진은 미래와 마을 중 하나를 선택해야 한다.
cards.english_desc: Yun Ji-hyun’s novel follows Soojin, who revives her drowned sister Mirae. Soojin breaks ancestral magic rules because she cannot accept losing Mirae. After Mirae returns, strange deaths and destructive rain threaten their town. Soojin must decide whether to keep Mirae or protect the community.
cards.hook: A girl brings her drowned sister back.
cards.takeaway_english: The ghosts are frightening, but the deepest subject is the wish to undo death.
cards.takeaway_korean: 귀신보다 더 깊은 주제는 죽음을 되돌리고 싶은 마음이다.

why_it_matters.english: The novel connects Korean folklore with Korean American family experience.
why_it_matters.korean: 소설은 한국 설화와 한국계 미국인 가족을 연결한다.

why_it_matters.english: It treats grief as a long process rather than one dramatic moment.

parties.label: Yun Ji-hyun
parties.english: The Korean American writer shaped grief into a young-adult horror novel.
parties.korean: 한국계 미국인 작가는 슬픔을 청소년 소설로 만들었다.

parties.label: Soojin
parties.english: The younger sister breaks family magic rules to revive Mirae.
parties.korean: 동생 수진은 마법 규칙을 깨고 미래를 살린다.

parties.label: Readers
parties.english: They can face frightening emotions at their own pace through fiction.
parties.korean: 독자는 소설로 무서운 감정을 천천히 마주한다.

views.label: Yun Ji-hyun
views.english: She says horror gives internal fears a physical shape and offers an emotional toolkit.
views.korean: 윤지현은 공포가 내면의 두려움을 보여준다고 말한다.

views.label: Kirkus Reviews
views.english: The review calls the novel both creepy and deeply focused on grief and sisterhood.
views.korean: 커커스는 작품이 무섭고 슬픔과 자매애를 다룬다고 평했다.

disagree.english: Some readers may focus on the supernatural plot, while the writer emphasizes grief beneath it.
disagree.korean: 독자는 초자연 이야기와 슬픔 중 다르게 볼 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Ryu Ji-hyuk Finally Hits His First Postseason Homer
cards.korean_desc: 10월 29일 류지혁이 KIA전 3차전에서 투런포를 쳤다. 그 홈런으로 삼성은 5회 4대3으로 앞섰다. KIA가 동점으로 만들었지만 삼성은 7회 두 점을 냈다. 삼성은 6대4로 이겨 시리즈를 2대1로 앞섰다.
cards.english_desc: On October 29, Ryu Ji-hyuk hit a two-run homer against Kia in Game 3. The homer gave Samsung a 4-3 lead in the fifth inning. Kia tied the game, but Samsung scored twice in the seventh. Samsung won 6-4 and took a 2-1 series lead over Kia.
cards.hook: Ryu Ji-hyuk hit his first postseason homer.
cards.takeaway_english: Ryu’s rare power arrived when Samsung needed a playoff turning point.
cards.takeaway_korean: 류지혁의 드문 장타가 삼성에 전환점을 안겼다.

why_it_matters.english: One swing changed the lead in a playoff game.
why_it_matters.korean: 한 번의 스윙이 플레이오프 리드를 바꿨다.

why_it_matters.english: The win put Samsung one victory from the Korean Series.

parties.label: Ryu Ji-hyuk
parties.english: He hit a go-ahead two-run homer against his former team.
parties.korean: 그는 친정팀을 상대로 역전 투런포를 쳤다.

parties.label: Samsung Lions
parties.english: The Lions won Game 3 and moved ahead 2-1 in the series.

parties.label: Kia Tigers
parties.english: The Tigers lost despite tying the game in the sixth inning.

views.label: Ryu Ji-hyuk
views.english: He said he treated Kia as another opponent instead of chasing revenge.
views.korean: 류지혁은 KIA를 복수 대상이 아닌 상대라고 했다.

views.label: Samsung-focused coverage
views.english: The homer was presented as a key momentum shift in Samsung’s 6-4 victory.
views.korean: 삼성 중심 보도는 홈런을 승리의 전환점으로 봤다.

disagree.english: The game also depended on later scoring and pitching, so one homer did not decide everything alone.
disagree.korean: 후속 득점과 투구도 중요해 홈런만으로 결정되지는 않았다.

cards.english_title: Boynextdoor Takes Its First Tour Across North America
cards.korean_desc: 6인조 그룹은 미국, 캐나다, 멕시코에서 공연한다. 북미 일정에는 댈러스, 플로리다, 시카고, 뉴욕, 토론토가 있다. 북미 뒤에는 2027년 1월까지 아시아 6곳을 돈다.
cards.english_desc: The six-member group will perform across the United States, Canada and Mexico. The North American leg includes Dallas, Florida, Chicago, New York and Toronto. After North America, the group will continue touring six Asian regions into January 2027.
cards.hook: Boynextdoor begins its first North American tour.
cards.takeaway_english: The North American leg is the group’s biggest international test so far.
cards.takeaway_korean: 북미 공연은 지금까지 가장 큰 해외 시험이다.

why_it_matters.english: More fans can experience the group’s music outside Asia.
why_it_matters.korean: 아시아 밖 팬들도 그룹 음악을 직접 경험할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The tour tests how far the group’s audience has grown.

cards.english_title: Ukraine Talks Await Middle East Developments
cards.korean_desc: 러시아는 날짜가 없다고 했고 젤렌스키는 아부다비를 바랐다. 제안된 형식은 러시아, 우크라이나, 미국의 세 나라다. 10월 29일 러시아는 유럽 협상가를 고려하지 않는다고 했다.
cards.english_desc: Russia said no date was fixed, while Zelenskyy hoped for November 6 to 10 in Abu Dhabi. The proposed format includes Russia, Ukraine and the United States. As of October 29, Russia said European negotiators were not being considered.
cards.hook: The next Ukraine talks may depend on the Middle East.
cards.takeaway_english: No meeting date is fixed, and the format itself remains disputed.
cards.takeaway_korean: 회담 날짜는 없고 참여 방식도 여전히 논쟁 중이다.

why_it_matters.english: A delay keeps diplomacy uncertain during a conflict that has lasted four and a half years.
why_it_matters.korean: 회담 지연은 4년 반 이어진 전쟁의 외교를 불확실하게 만든다.

why_it_matters.english: The participants could shape how any ceasefire discussion moves forward.
why_it_matters.korean: 참여국은 휴전 논의의 방향에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: It has not proposed a specific date for the next talks.
parties.korean: 러시아는 다음 회담의 구체적 날짜를 제안하지 않았다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: President Zelenskyy hopes for talks in Abu Dhabi from November 6 to 10.

parties.label: Europe
parties.english: Britain, Germany and France say Europe should play a role.
parties.korean: 영국, 독일, 프랑스는 유럽도 역할을 해야 한다고 했다.

views.label: Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov
views.english: The Middle East conflict and battlefield situation make near-term talks uncertain.
views.korean: 중동 전쟁과 전장 상황 때문에 가까운 회담은 불확실하다고 했다.

views.label: Ukraine and European leaders
views.english: A meeting should continue, and Europe should not be left outside negotiations.
views.korean: 회담은 계속돼야 하며 유럽이 협상에서 빠지면 안 된다고 했다.

disagree.english: Russia emphasizes timing and a three-country format, while Ukraine and Europe seek broader participation.
disagree.korean: 러시아는 시기와 세 나라 형식을 강조하고 우크라이나와 유럽은 참여 확대를 원한다.
